name: navigate_to_region
description: Navigate to a named waypoint loaded from XML by wp_map_tools; no object search or approach.

region.description: Exact saved waypoint Name in the loaded XML, e.g. kitchen, bedroom, or 1.

name: get_robot_pose
description: Read the current localized map -> base_footprint pose from TF2; no motion.

name: navigate_to_pose
description: Navigate to an x, y, yaw pose in the map frame.

name: approach_object
description: Prefer the closest tested goal to the object with 10 cm centre clearance outside inflation on the robot-facing semicircle. If unavailable, prefer the largest available margin. Goal centres stay outside inflation, with a footprint clear of solid obstacles and unknown space. Use a fresh confirmed Vision MCP map-frame surface point. Pass confirm_object structured_content unchanged; target reconfirmation after motion is separate.

confirmed_observation.description: Complete successful structured_content returned by Vision MCP confirm_object.

name: cancel_navigation
description: Cancel the active navigation operation and confirm its Nav2 goals have terminated. Safe to call when idle.

name: get_follow_target
description: Read the nearest fresh unambiguous depth-valid person; identity_id is null for an unknown person. No movement. This is proximity selection, not speaker identification.

name: follow_person
description: Start real continuous person following. Supply a freshly resolved enrolled identity_id to follow directly without enrollment. Omit identity_id to enroll the nearest unknown person without a name, confirm recognition, then follow. enabled=false stops and confirms termination. Success means started, not completed.

name: get_following_status
description: Read selected identity, operation ID, current following state and latest error. No movement.

name: remember_person
description: Enroll the single visible person with their stated name and confirm face recognition; never automatically retry.

name: find_person
description: Find a previously enrolled person by name in the current camera view.
